_doc: Our own wording for GUI keys that a dependency references but never defines. Each row is {"key": "STR_...", "text": "..."}; the text is written by us, never copied from a dependency. The key list comes from native RPT evidence (python3 -B -m tools.package.compat_stringtable --rpt <RPT> lists uncovered keys); it is empty until the lead fills it. See docs/tools/COMPAT_ADDON.md.
